featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved Chan’s Patisserie & Bakery. Such a cute little spot with some seriously memorable bakes.

The lemon tart was an absolute banger. Perfectly tangy, balanced, and super fresh. The pesto bun and Korean cheese bun were equally amazing, packed with flavour and incredibly soft. A cozy little bakery that gets both the vibe and the food right. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in the mood for comforting, well made desserts and bakes.

Got a refund, but never going back. If you want clean, premium cakes, try:

Dear Febin Raju,

We sincerely apologize for your experience and are truly sorry to hear about what happened during such an important occasion for your father’s birthday. Finding a hair in the cake and feeling that your concerns were not handled appropriately is not the experience we want any customer to have.

Please know that hygiene and customer experience are extremely important to us, and feedback like yours is taken seriously. We will review this internally with our team to help improve our standards and customer handling.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We appreciate your feedback and regret that we could not meet your expectations on this occasion.

In conclusion, Symposia Bakery in Vasai is a must-visit for anyone who appreciates high-quality baked goods. The mango and Nutella cheesecakes are particularly noteworthy and are highly recommended.
